title: pendingPhUSD() and pendingStable() revert (underflow) for users who used pauseWithdraw, breaking dashboards / integrators
rootCause: Both view helpers compute `(userDetails.amount * _accX) / PRECISION - userDetails.XDebt`. They share the same underflow path as `_claimRewards` (DEDUP-002): after a `pauseWithdraw` reduces `user.amount` while leaving the debt anchored to the pre-pause amount, the subtraction underflows on Solidity 0.8 checked arithmetic.

invariant.note: Same shrunk counterexample as DEDUP-002 because the invariant asserts on the view helpers directly.

symbolic.claim: Halmos counterexample for pendingPhUSD view-helper underflow on realistic inputs.
Halmos counterexample for pendingStable view-helper underflow with multiple witnesses.

impactSummary: Front-ends, indexers, and on-chain integrators (zap helpers, aggregators, governance dashboards) revert when calling pendingPhUSD/pendingStable for affected users. View-DoS is independent of and additional to the mutating-path DoS (DEDUP-002).
preservedDetails: CODE-007 carries the integrator-facing narrative. SYMBOLIC-003 and SYMBOLIC-004 verify reachability symbolically with concrete witnesses.
remediation: Clamp the subtraction in both view helpers: `return X >= Y ? X - Y : 0;`. Same clamp pattern as proposed for DEDUP-002.
dedupNotes: Kept separate from DEDUP-002 because impact (view-DoS for off-chain readers) is distinct from mutating-path DoS even though arithmetic primitive is shared. Sanitizer should expect submission to bundle these in remediation but classify view-side at Medium and mutating at High.
